core_axiom: The body knows before the law finishes speaking.
primary_tension: freedom through instinctive force, not planned permission
high_level_read: impulse and instinct are trusted before abstraction
the body is a source of truth
terrain, creatures, and emotion are active forces
growth matters when it becomes motion

core_axes.question: What does the body know before thought arrives?
core_axes.ui_signal: move before the room explains itself

core_axes.question: Do you need speed now or size next?
Is this card a creature or an impact?
What happens when blockers stop being enough?
What if land is not scenery?
What breaks law, machinery, control, or delay?
When do many bodies become a stampede?

archetypes.name: The Riot Spark
archetypes.drive: force the first move before control stabilizes

archetypes.name: The Bloodrush Translator
archetypes.drive: turn a creature card into a combat event
archetypes.line: The body does not have to enter the battlefield to hit.

archetypes.name: The Stomping Ground
archetypes.drive: make terrain part of the attack
archetypes.line: The land is not passive under Gruul feet.

archetypes.name: The Anti-Machine
archetypes.drive: punish delicate systems, control shells, and engineered delay

archetypes.name: The Apex Charge
archetypes.drive: make one threat large enough to collapse the problem
archetypes.line: One body can become the whole stampede.

archetypes.name: The Pack Engine
archetypes.drive: let one creature make the next creature more dangerous

drift_guardrails.rakdos: Remove performance language. Add land, body, impact, trample, or anti-obstacle pressure.
drift_guardrails.golgari: Replace burial/rot language with stomp, charge, land, bloodrush, riot, or aftershock.
drift_guardrails.selesnya: Make the group physical and untamed, not peaceful or moralized.
drift_guardrails.simic: Remove laboratory/perfection language. Add instinctive size, territory, and collision.
drift_guardrails.boros: Remove duty, formation, and justice. Add impulse, wildness, and physical consequence.

compression_line: If it blocks life, hit it with life.
